title: volkameria orientalis var. indica
intro: Volkameria orientalis var. indica, commonly known as Indian Volkameria or Indian Teasellove, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is widely used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Indian Volkameria include its ability to act as an expectorant, a carminative, and a diaphoretic, which can help relieve respiratory issues, ease digestion, and induce sweating to help with fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Indian Volkameria include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
